name: Alima
long_description: Alima is a supply chain tech company that simplifies how businesses procure fresh goods in Latin America. We help restaurants, CPG brands, and retailers plan their buying orders, ordering products, expense management, and logistics.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Co-Founder & CEO of Alima
Prev: Head of Tech at ByPrice.com, +5 years developing software solutions, and leading data & engineering teams.  Founded Tuibo, a smart garment for cyclists. Former Robotics Lecturer at UNAM, and RA in Deep RL at CLVR Lab, USC.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: I have +15 years experience working for big companies and startups (Coca Cola FEMSA, Amazon, Uber). Background on Growth, Mkt, BD and CX. My passion is to build high performing teams, beat targets and achieve great results together. MBA in Escuela Europea de Dirección y Empresa (Spain), founder of Equal at Uber (social class ERG) and I’m a mom since August 2021!

founders.title: Founder

Founder FINCAH / Google Analytics Program Manager / Ex-Alima Cofounder & COO / Ex-Accenture, Ex-Unilever.

Advanced business analytics, supply chain management, and operations.
